Introduction

HoloDeck runs agents defined in YAML through provider backends. Each backend adapts the agent definition to the provider SDK.

Configuration

An agent file lists the model, the instructions and the tools. Tools can search documents, call MCP servers or run Python functions.
Every field is validated before the agent starts.

Evaluation

Test cases pair an input with expected tools and ground truth. Metrics score each response, and the run report lists every failure with its reason.

Deployment

The serve command exposes the agent over HTTP. Containers package the agent with its configuration for cloud hosting.
